name: Hikawa Kirara
source:
A flashy and playful girl, who's kind to her friends. She speaks very bluntly, which can sometimes make her come off as a bit cold.

Since her parents are always at work, she's happy being surrounded by her companions. She dislikes difficult things, and wants to just happily live in the moment.

[translated from Getchu]
